### Key Considerations for Brand Selection

When evaluating which brand to partner with, owners should weigh the following factors:

1. **Location type:**

citations.cited_text: Europe’s geographic advantages with Mediterranean coastlines and mountain ranges also naturally favour resort oriented developments, providing the ide...
citations.title: Branded Residences in Europe Continue to Attract Brands, Developers and Buyers

content.text: Europe's geographic advantages with Mediterranean coastlines and mountain ranges naturally favour resort-oriented developments, providing the ideal settings for luxury property investment, whether it is a primary residence or a second home.

Brands like Six Senses, Fairmont, and Four Seasons are particularly strong in resorts; Mandarin Oriental and Marriott flagship brands tend to anchor urban projects.

2. **Pipeline & active markets:**

citations.cited_text: Turkey leads European countries with 40 branded residential developments nationwide, followed by the United Kingdom and Spain. Turkey also boasts the ...
citations.title: Branded Residences in Europe Continue to Attract Brands, Developers and Buyers

content.text: Turkey leads European countries with 40 branded residential developments, followed by the United Kingdom and Spain. Turkey also boasts the largest pipeline of future projects, with Portugal, Greece, and Spain following closely behind.
3. **Co-location model:**

citations.cited_text: The preference for co-location in Europe reflects buyers’ desire for immediate access to hotel amenities and services, which remain a significant sell...
citations.title: Branded Residences in Europe Continue to Attract Brands, Developers and Buyers

content.text: The preference for co-location in Europe reflects buyers' desire for immediate access to hotel amenities and services, which remain a significant selling point in the European market.
4. **Brand premium:**

citations.cited_text: Brand premiums constantly evolve as new brands enter the · space across various chain scales, diverse industries, during · diﬀerent stages of the econ...
citations.title: Branded Residences

content.text: Brand premiums constantly evolve as new brands enter the space across various chain scales and diverse industries; between 2023 and 2024, the average brand premium within Europe advanced by two percentage points to 29%.
5. **Service infrastructure:**

citations.cited_text: These developments appeal to buyers seeking consistency: 24/7 concierge, housekeeping, security, dining and spa access are no longer optional, but exp...
citations.title: Badge of honour: What different brands bring to Branded Residential developments

content.text: These developments appeal to buyers seeking consistency — 24/7 concierge, housekeeping, security, dining and spa access — and hotel brands often run the maintenance and rental program on behalf of the owner, offering seamless end-to-end management.

In summary, **Marriott International** (especially Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, and W), **Accor** (Fairmont, Raffles, Orient Express), and **Four Seasons** are the dominant global forces with the strongest track records in Europe, while **Six Senses**, **Mandarin Oriental**, **Radisson Blu**, **Aman**, and **Rosewood** offer compelling niche options depending on the location, target market, and project positioning.
